whenToUse: Files carried by a chat turn, as chips in a composer tray or cards in an assistant reply
Upload queues and pickers where each file reads as idle, uploading, processing, failed or done
Rows of image thumbnails or file chips that scroll sideways on one line instead of wrapping

whenNotToUse.when: A drop zone that takes files dragged in from the desktop
A colored format badge that labels a document by its extension, such as PDF
An upload list where each row needs a bar filling toward 100 percent

agentNotes: `Attachment` uploads nothing and only styles the `state` you pass, so set `state` from your own transfer code
The radix `Button` behind `AttachmentAction` sets no `type`, so pass `type` button inside a `form` or it submits
